assumptions.external_seed_definition: USDT paid in; equal-value own-token leg is separately minted as bootstrap liability
assumptions.main_debt_policy: 50% of fixed-FX instantaneous issuance boundary; illustrative, not recommended
assumptions.path: Observed candle closes; close supplied at candle end, ETH last known hourly close
assumptions.finite_inventory: No own-token sales beyond issued supply outside pool; all issued tokens initially in pool
assumptions.unlimited_inventory: Diagnostic clearing benchmark: hypothetical outside route can supply tokens beyond total issued. Deficits reported; infeasible without additional issuance/backing mechanism.
assumptions.refuels: Quote-only daily spend at first observed close of local day; source seven-day unlock and 10% outstanding-share cap; no preloaded buffer
assumptions.pnl: Recoverable inventory at external parity; LP versus HODL; treasury LP less bootstrap liability and spent refuels; no interest, hedge, redemption or realized liquidation simulation
assumptions.gas: Refuel transaction assumed 250000 gas; no measured deployment gas. Arbitrage gas paid by arbitrageurs through min-profit assumption, not treasury.
